cases.input: An iteration closes planning with ten WorkItems and a capacity snapshot.
cases.expect: An immutable commitment baseline is sealed at planning close.

cases.input: An urgent WorkItem is added after planning close.
cases.expect: A scope-change record cites actor, reason and time; the baseline remains unchanged.

cases.input: Two incomplete WorkItems move into the successor iteration.
cases.expect: Explicit successor memberships preserve the prior commitment and incomplete outcome.

cases.input: Post-close additions silently replace the original committed membership.
cases.expect: The rewrite is rejected and append-only scope-change evidence is required.

cases.input: Closing the iteration marks every WorkItem accepted.
cases.expect: The inference is rejected because acceptance requires separate authority and evidence.

cases.input: Historical velocity is copied as current capacity with no declared assumptions.
cases.expect: The capacity declaration is invalid until its basis, units and assumptions are explicit.

cases.input: Cancelling an iteration deletes its commitment and scope changes.
cases.expect: The deletion is rejected; cancellation preserves commitment and disposition history.
